name: app-usage
title: App Usage
description: See your screen time and which apps you actually use. Track locally and ask Raycast AI about your usage.
author: GouravAkaJojo

commands.name: collect
commands.title: Collect Usage
commands.subtitle: App Usage
commands.description: Records the focused application once a minute. Runs automatically in the background. Disabling this stops all tracking.

commands.name: report
commands.title: Usage Report
commands.subtitle: App Usage
commands.description: See which applications you have used and for how long.

commands.name: days
commands.title: Daily Usage
commands.subtitle: App Usage
commands.description: Browse the last seven days, one day at a time.

tools.name: get-usage-report
tools.title: Get Usage Report
tools.description: Read tracked app usage, idle time, and hourly activity for today, yesterday, the last 7 days, or the last 30 days only. For other periods, including last year, use range unsupported and ask the user to choose a supported period. Does not change or delete data.

preferences.name: retentionDays
preferences.title: Keep History For
preferences.description: Days of history to retain before older data is pruned.

preferences.name: excludedApps
preferences.title: Excluded Apps
preferences.description: Comma-separated app names to never record. These are never written to disk.
